gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-meetei-mayek: Noto Sans Meetei Mayek has rounds that gap like a cracked bangle and big lowercase eyes, so it feels modern and open. Oxanium above it draws everything with one marker tip.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-mende-kikaku: Oxanium's strokes look cut from rod stock. Noto Sans Mende Kikakui sits beneath it with light in every curve, and its lowercase stands tall against the capitals.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Sharp, commanding, a little sci-fi. Noto Sans Meroitic follows with open c shapes and lowercase that fills the line like capitals, so paragraphs of it read friendly and easy to enter, while Oxanium keeps its round bowls uniform.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-modi: Bold and techy up top, Oxanium keeps rounds and stems in one weight, while Noto Sans Modi opens daylight inside every curve below. Long text would feel clean and modern.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-mono: Noto Sans Mono spaces its letters generously so they never bump, and its tall lowercase makes words look sturdy beside Oxanium. Both refuse thin horizontals.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-mro: Oxanium draws every line weight with a signage-like plainness, flat and deliberate. Noto Sans Mro then packs dense, tall words with wide entrances into each letter, so extended reading stays modern and brisk.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-multani: Hard-edged and futuristic, Oxanium never mixes bold-looking and light-looking strokes inside a word, while Noto Sans Multani lifts a lofty x-height and an e with a wide terminal gap. That lofty, modern body is the strongest thing here.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Professional in feel, Oxanium holds a constant pen pressure look across every letter, and Noto Sans Myanmar answers with a heavy-looking strip of text and a welcoming c. The thick, dark body is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Oxanium holds unshaded, constant strokes. Noto Sans Nabataean sits below with lowercase almost cap-tall and wide-open s curves, so a long page of it would feel professional and contemporary.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-nag-mundari: Oxanium has a line width that never swells or tapers, giving it a commanding, distinctive look. Noto Sans Nag Mundari follows with half-unwrapped c and s shapes and lowercase rivaling the capitals, making longer reading feel contemporary and sturdy.
